title: Prove the shared packet 3300 obstruction in the early chart-268 route
body:
## Result

For the pinned early 0→19 x549 family, owners 184 and 189 require incompatible responses from the same scalar packet 3300. The case gates let 1584 use its actual source space, grant early feedback just after native clock 10388, allow arbitrary causal recoding on the exact 344-sender roster, and free every terminal decoder. Productive endpoints, the stated early packet equations and other clocks remain fixed. The final four cases grant every other mutable sender its source envelope. Both required rows lie outside their terminal known spaces, so both need the common scalar. The two probes vanish on the respective terminal spaces, and their sum vanishes on the shared 18-dimensional source space. Their target evaluations differ. The joint quotient rank is 13, or 14 after adjoining the demand pair.

A separate literal diagnostic restores all 537 chart-1 targets and keeps owners 221, 411 and 679 exact in both orientations. It has 64 forward and 127 adjoint errors elsewhere. Its formal 36-call BIT price is +0.15481217569851 at 0.00388, and the separate unchanged 48-call rational price is +0.13897452233425. Outer application admission and physical erasure remain open. No higher κ is asserted.

## Replay

Cold extraction passed both manifests and the full `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -I -B verify_all.py` suite. The independent `lowprobe-371.py` reconstructs the native primitive, the exact 344-label closure and strict first-reader banks before replaying the dual at the stated new-contact clock. A separate literal and invoice review independently checks the 537 chart-1 rows, protected owners and both signed profiles. Native #7786 is `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`.

## Prior work and open next questions

#8012 `d6efaa1893dc033a05fcfa06e6bd25393ba2df1c` changes the early equations, #8018 `405cbc9f1c457d5cb45a5bcffd883717d0b43bc9` fixes a named coefficient projection, and #8019 `1cfbd53554154a3bb0b18b8ee607bb6c8ceaa37d` optimizes a different feedback stock. #8020 `9a1f6c33ff7ec0383e726c4bc95e7b7276048b23` reaches both complete native operators by rebinding a productive input. Seek an independently arriving old direction that changes either quotient demand without using the same packet 3300, or release a fixed early equation and recompute the true causal stock.

A ChatGPT Pro consultation supplied the initial proof and diagnostic. Independent replay and scope review used OpenAI Codex.
